source_geometry_note: Source celestial line features are locally projected to 2D and normalized by the longest bounding-box dimension; this is schematic geometry, not a sky simulation.
retention_note: All 30 non-Orion templates are byte-equivalent in data to v3. Orion preserves its original 9-core topology and adds a 9-point bow arc from d3-celestial; the original v3 Orion remains available unchanged in templates-v3.json.

Ori.name: Orion (18 stars, extended bow)
Ori.reference: d3-celestial Orion bow arc and shoulder connection; original nine-point core preserved by a common similarity transform

geometry_provenance.core_source: templates-v3.json:templates.Ori (9 points, nine edges; preserved by uniform normalization)
